commands: ^client (?:denied by server configuration|used wrong authentication scheme)\b
^([A-Z]\w+: )?user `<F-USER>(?:[^']*|.*?)</F-USER>' in realm `.+' (auth(?:oriz|entic)ation failure|not found|denied by provider)\b
^([A-Z]\w+: )?invalid nonce .*? received - user attempted time travel\b
^(?:No h|H)ostname \S+ provided via SNI(?:, but no hostname provided| and hostname \S+ provided| for a name based virtual host)\b

nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'
^ LOG\d\[\d+:\d+\]:\ SSL_accept from <HOST>:\d+ : (?P<CODE>[\dA-F]+): error:(?P=CODE):SSL routines:SSL3_GET_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE:peer did not return a certificate$

nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '0:65535' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '0:65535' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '0:65535' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '0:65535' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -j f2b-directadmin
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-directadmin
<iptables> -X f2b-directadmin

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -j f2b-directadmin
done; done

files.jail.local:
[directadmin]
enabled = true
backend = auto
logpath = /nonexistent/%(__name__)s.log
maxretry =  3 
bantime = 600
action = iptables-allports[name=%(__name__)s]
[stunnel]
enabled = true
maxretry = 10
[apache-auth]
enabled = true
logpath = /dev/null
          /nonexistent/y
maxretry = 10
bantime = %(findtime)s
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=ddos]
ignoreip = 
port = http,https
